title: Matthew Driver “Trust Is A Critical Component” | Perspectives | Channel NewsAsia
summary: A short Channel NewsAsia interview clip in which MasterCard's Southeast Asia president voices distrust of cryptocurrencies produced by anonymous computers in anonymous places. It is part of the Perspectives series and runs about four minutes.
why: Cited, usually critically, as a window into how payment companies view cryptocurrency and cash.

quote.text: These statements from an executive at MasterCard are a great window into the company's designs on cash and its electronic corollaries
